title: Storybook data
description: The single source of storybook data. `items` is the sidebar tree: its depth is the navigation structure and its order is the sidebar order. See manifest/.reports/storybook-data/plan.md.

columns.description: Named column sets. A table references one by name; each column carries its own width, so there is no separate index-aligned widths list.

defaults.description: Settings every item inherits; any item or folder can override a key.

oneOf.description: A page, named by the string.
A folder ({ name: [items] }), a page with settings ({ name: {…} }), or a folder with settings ({ name: { …, items: [items] } }).

settings.description: An item's settings. They cascade to every descendant; plain objects (widths) merge key by key, everything else replaces. `items` is reserved for a folder's children.

table.description: The column set (a `columns` key) this page renders as a data table; false marks a hand-written page inside a table folder.

widths.description: Column width overrides by column key, e.g. { "preview": "8em" }.

description.description: Prose under the page title. `backticks` render as inline code.

variants.description: Rows, in order. Omit to read the token group's variants from nice-styles. An object row carries `variant` plus data its renderer needs.

preview.description: Renderer id, only when this page shares another item's renderer. Defaults to the item's own id.

wrapped.description: Cap the docs page at nice-storybook-theme's contentMaxWidth.

sectionWrapped.description: Cap each data-table section's heading at contentMaxWidth (its rows stay full width).

column.description: One table column. Mirrors DataColumn in src/components/DataTable, plus `width`.

key.description: Stable identity; also the React key for its cells.

header.description: Header label; null renders an empty header cell.

render.description: Omit to render the value as-is (a node). nice-react-ink: the value wrapped in Ink, styled by code/size/color. nice-react-code: a code string rendered by the nice Code component, inlined.

size.description: (nice-react-ink) Ink font size — a fontSize variant.

color.description: (nice-react-ink) Nice text color — a color variant.

width.description: Fixed width from tablet up (e.g. "8em"); omit for equal flex.
